response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates extensive full-stack development experience across multiple languages and frameworks, with over 12 years in software engineering. His recent role in AI-agent infrastructure aligns well with the primary stack (TypeScript, Node.js, React) and secondary technologies (Kotlin/Java). His contributions to scalable systems (e.g., handling millions of HTTP requests) and open-source projects show technical depth and collaboration skills, though some recent roles lack explicit mention of Vitest or Nest.js.
strengths: Strong full-stack expertise across TypeScript, Node.js, and React with demonstrated scalability in high-traffic systems
Deep experience with AI-agent development and modern architectures (e.g., MCP, Model Context Protocol)
Proven leadership in open-source contributions and mentorship (e.g., Refactoring Dojos, Selenium courses)
concerns: Limited explicit mention of Nest.js or Vitest in recent roles, though TypeScript/Node.js experience is extensive
Recent employment history shows frequent role changes (every 2-3 years), which may raise questions about long-term commitment
No direct experience with PostgreSQL or Kubernetes in listed recent roles, though MongoDB and Docker are covered

key_factors.factor: Recent role stability and primary stack alignment
